item.title: Quadruple amputee, professional cornhole player faces murder charges
item.description: A professional cornhole player and quadruple amputee has been formally charged with murder and multiple related offenses in connection with a deadly shooting that occurred in Charles County on March 22, 2026.

item.title: Suspicious package closed Capitol Visitor Center screening areas, several nearby roads Monday
item.description: A suspicious package found Monday on the East Plaza of the U.S. Capitol prompted the closure of screening areas at the Capitol Visitor Center and several surrounding roads, U.S. Capitol Police said.

item.title: US Park Police officer shot, injured in DC
item.description: A member of the United States Park Police was shot Monday in Southeast Washington, D.C., according to the D.C. Police Union.

item.title: US Park Police officer released from hospital after DC ambush shooting; suspect search continues
item.description: A U.S. Park Police officer has been released from the hospital after being seriously wounded Monday in the District after being shot in what the agency’s chief described as an ambush.

item.title: ICE agents seen at Reagan National, Dulles as shutdown strains TSA staffing
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents have been spotted at both Reagan National and Dulles International airports as the partial federal government shutdown continues to affect Transportation Security Administration staffing.

item.title: DC weather: Chilly, dry Tuesday before midweek warm up
item.description: Chilly and dry conditions across the Washington, D.C. region Tuesday, marking one of the cooler days of the week.

item.title: Where to see cherry blossoms with part of Tidal Basin closed for construction
item.description: While part of the iconic viewing area is off-limits, there are still plenty of spots across D.C. where you can enjoy cherry blossoms this spring.

item.title: Prince George’s County highlights AI, quantum computing investments
item.description: Prince George’s County leaders are spotlighting the region’s growing role in artificial intelligence and quantum computing.

item.title: What we know about Dayton Webber, quadruple amputee cornhole player charged with murder
item.description: A Maryland man known as a quadruple amputee and competitive cornhole player is now facing murder charges. Here’s a closer look at the case and his background.

item.title: Cherry Blossom Forecast: Peak bloom could arrive within days
item.description: Conditions are lining up for Washington, D.C.’s famous cherry blossom trees to reach peak bloom as early as this week!

item.title: 'An absolute tragedy:' Family, friends remember Dr. Cerina Fairfax’s legacy
item.description: The family, friends and attorney of Dr. Cerina Fairfax are speaking out following her death in an apparent murder-suicide involving her husband, former Virginia Lt. Gov. Justin Fairfax.

item.title: Budget fight could cost Prince William schools $31M
item.description: A budget dispute is intensifying in Prince William County just days before a final vote, with school leaders warning a proposed change could leave them with more than $31 million less than expected.

item.title: Prince George’s County clerk speaks out after daytime armed carjacking
item.description: A Prince George’s County clerk is speaking out after she says she was carjacked at gunpoint in broad daylight.

item.title: Virginia voters near decision on high-stakes redistricting vote
item.description: Virginia voters are just days away from deciding on a high-profile redistricting measure that could reshape the state’s congressional map and carry national political implications. With early voting already underway, turnout in key regions may play a decisive role in the outcome.

item.title: Surge of 'snatch and grab' thefts in Northern Virginia: police
item.description: A woman in Loudoun County was robbed of her jewelry and injured as suspects fled in what authorities say is the latest in a series of "snatch and grab" thefts across the region.
